The [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 ''Home One'' type Star Cruiser]] [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']] contained an '''awards auditorium''', for awarding its personnel various medals for their service to the Rebel Alliance. [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] frequently presented the medals to the members of the awarded personnel in person.

==History==
It was utilized from [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] to award the Rebel [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Keyan Farlander/Legends|Keyan Farlander]] for his actions in service to the Rebel Alliance in various campaigns, with the exception of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Star of Alderaan/Legends|Star of Alderaan]], where he was instead awarded at the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple's]] [[Grand Audience Chamber]] prior to the [[Royal Award Ceremony/Legends|Royal Award Ceremony]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)}}
In addition to the [[Corellian Cross/Legends|Corellian Cross]], [[Mantooine Medallion/Legends|Mantooine Medallion]], [[Shield of Yavin]], and [[Talons of Hoth]], Farlander had also been presented with the [[Kalidor Crescent/Legends|Kalidor Crescent]], which he had gradually managed to receive all five embellishments: The [[Bronze Cluster/Legends|Bronze Cluster]], the [[Silver Talons/Legends|Silver Talons]], the [[Silver Scimitar/Legends|Silver Scimitar]], the [[Golden Wings/Legends|Golden Wings]] and the [[Diamond Eyes/Legends|Diamond Eyes]].
{{Endgame}}

==Layout==
The room was spacious, being at least three stories high with floors that can accompany at least two soldiers per upper floor. A large banner extending down to the ground floor from as high as the top of the room was prominently displayed, with the [[Alliance Starbird]] being prominently displayed in white contrasting with the primarily blue fabric. Despite the room's size, it was fairly simple, composed of only a small stage and 24 starfighter pilots (12 for each side of the aisle) standing in front of it.
